workarounds.symptom: Nested env var is not JSON-decoded when a dict field's value type contains another dict
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix JSON decoding of nested dictionary environment values. Target files: pydantic_settings/sources/providers/env.py, tests/test_settings.py. For `dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]]`, an environment value such as `APP_VALUES__X='[{"k":"v"}]'` reaches validation as a string. `next_field()` descends into the dictionary's type arguments before recognizing the dictionary itself, losing the value's container type. Handle the outer dictionary first so the value is decoded at the correct nesting level. . (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1109)

workarounds.symptom: Union value type of a dict field is not JSON-decoded from nested env vars (unlike union fields)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Decode nested dictionary values with complex union types. Target files: pydantic_settings/sources/base.py, pydantic_settings/sources/providers/env.py, tests/test_settings.py. When `env_nested_delimiter` resolves an environment variable to a dictionary value typed as `list[str] | str` or `list[str] | None`, the source treats the raw union annotation as a scalar. JSON lists stay as strings, leading to an incorrect value or a validation error. The same annotation on a model field is already decoded. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1089)

workarounds.symptom: NameError at init when a discriminated union default is a local dataclass
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Resolve only the discriminator annotation of stdlib dataclass defaults. Target files: pydantic_settings/sources/base.py, tests/test_settings.py. closes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/issues/1066 (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1077)

workarounds.symptom: pydantic-settings v2.16.1: Fixed-length tuple positionals such as `CliPositionalArg[tuple[int, int]]` and `NamedTuple`s are single-valued again ([#1069](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/106
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fixed-length tuple positionals such as `CliPositionalArg[tuple[int, int]]` and `NamedTuple`s are single-valued again ([#1069](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1069)). Since 2.16.0 they were treated as variadic, so a CLI either refused to start with a `SettingsError` or put the wrong argument into the tuple. Variable-length tuples (`tuple[int, ...]` and bare `Tuple`) are still variadic.. Upstream PR #1069. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1069)

workarounds.symptom: CLI fixed-length tuple positionals are treated as variadic since 2.16.0
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep fixed-length tuple CLI positionals single-valued. Target files: pydantic_settings/sources/providers/cli.py, tests/test_source_cli.py. #972 started treating every `Sequence` subclass as a collection when deciding whether a CLI arg is an append action. For positionals, that also made fixed-length tuples variadic: `CliPositionalArg[tuple[int, int]]` and `CliPositionalArg[SomeNamedTuple]`. As a result, CLIs that worked on 2.15.0: - put the next positional's value into the tuple (`['[1,2]', 'bob']` failed validati... (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1069)

workarounds.symptom: CLI field typed as an alias of list[dict] merges the list into one dict
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep list of dicts CLI values as lists. Target files: pydantic_settings/sources/providers/cli.py, tests/test_source_cli.py. `_convert_append_action` registered a CLI field in `_cli_dict_args` whenever a `Mapping` appeared *anywhere* in its annotation. For `list[dict[str, int]]`, `_merge_parsed_list` then took the dict branch and folded every element into one dict, so validation failed with `Input should be a valid list`: (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/1049)

workarounds.symptom: Values from config files and CLI are ignored when alias and validation_alias differ
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix config file and CLI values being ignored when alias differs from validation_alias. workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Fields with unresolved forward references now emit a warning** ([#901](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/pull/901)). Settings sources can silently fail to resolve such fields; they now raise `IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning` telling you to call `model_rebuild()`.
